title: Unique Appliances — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Unique Appliances.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Off-Grid Appliances." Specialty tier. Unique Appliances specializes in propane-powered and off-grid appliances — refrigerators, ranges, and freezers that run on propane for cottages, cabins, and off-grid living. Canadian company serving the rural market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Cottages, cabins, off-grid homes, rural properties without reliable electricity.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Unique Appliances:

• Only brand specializing in propane-powered home appliances

• Perfect for off-grid cottages and cabins

• Canadian company understanding rural Canadian needs

• Retro-styled propane fridges

• Solar-compatible DC options available
